body_plan: plant (stem body, leaf mass at top)
material: flexible stem, heavy head/leaf mass - an inverted pendulum; root/base fixed
volume_rule: no volume squash; bending only - motion originates at the base/stem, tip amplitude largest
rest_shape: canon cutout (sproutle.png - the no-baked-shadow version of record)

idle.description: ultra-slow sway 32-48f loop, base fixed, tip amplitude 4-8px equivalent, leaves lagging the stem in sequence (~2f per leaf outward); subtle growth-pulse height +1-2% as breathing equivalent
idle.secondary_break: one leaf shiver or a falling-leaf FX every few loops

locomotion.cycle: reach toward target over 12-24f with overshoot and sway-settle; if mobile, pot/root hop with full counter-swing

anticipation: lean AWAY + leaf fold before a reach/flinch response
settle: sway oscillation decaying over 16-24f (slowest settler in the cast - timing contrast vs the drop)

secondary_chains.behaviour: curve-lag chain, each leaf lags the stem 2-6f in sequence

signature_motions.name: phototropism lean
signature_motions.note: leans toward the speaker - his moving hold while listening

signature_motions.name: wilt
signature_motions.note: whole-form droop over 24f, recovery slower still

signature_motions.name: bloom-flare
signature_motions.note: bloom opens wide with leaf shiver

signature_motions.name: leaf-fold flinch
signature_motions.note: leaves fold in fast, unfold slow

emotion_map.happy: sway amplitude up, bloom open, leaves lifted
emotion_map.angry: stiff upright, leaves bristled, sway stops (contrast stillness)
emotion_map.scared: leaf-fold, tremble in the tips only

state_map.thirsty: droop baseline increases continuously until watered
state_map.watered: perk-up with leaf shiver, sway amplitude restored

forbidden_motions: tip moving before the base (motion must originate at base/stem)
smear_drawing: none (plants do not smear in this cast - timing contrast)
sound_linked_motions: cry = leaf shiver wave from base to tips

deform.note: bend-only: horizontal offset proportional to height above base
